title: GxHub
description: A fast, modern, and fully customizable hub plugin for Paper 1.21+ servers.
body:
GxHub is a lightweight hub plugin for Paper 1.21+ servers 😎🔥💻

It gives you all the basic hub features 💯 like setting spawn 🏠, auto teleport on join 🚀, server selector GUI 🎮📦, and full hub protection 🛡️😤

The plugin is simple 🙂, fast ⚡, and easy to configure ⚙️📁 so you don’t have to struggle 😵‍💫👍

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📌 How to Use 🚀
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Put the GxHub jar in your plugins folder 📂➡️📦  
2. Start/restart your server 🔄💻  
3. Use /gxhub setspawn to set hub 🏠📍  
4. Players auto teleport on join 🚀👤  
5. Use /hub anytime to go back 🔙🏠  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚙️ How it Works 🧠
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Plugin saves hub spawn 📍💾  
- On join → auto teleport 🚀👤  
- PvP ❌⚔️, damage ❌💔, block break ❌🧱 all disabled 🛡️😤  
- GUI lets players select servers 🎮📦  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📌 Notes 📢
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Works on Paper 1.21+ 💻✔️  
- Configure files before use ⚙️📁  

Made by GhostAimGG 👑😎🔥💯
